## Layout notes (measured 2026-10-03)

- Forest sheet is `640×640` = 5×5 grid of `128×128` cells. Row 0: tree canopies
  + bush; row 1: bush + dirt mounds; row 2: stumps + grass diamonds; row 3:
  isometric ground blocks; row 4: ground block, log piles, grass tuft, rock.
- Character sheets are `512×640` (4 cols × 4 rows of `128×160` frames:
  4 directions × idle/walk/attack sets — verify per sheet before use).
